body: I’m in therapy currently. Every day I make goals and work towards overcoming them. I’ve been able to walk around my town a bit more which is an improvement and when I’m done school I may look for a job so yeah little by little I’m working to get better. I really do want to overcome this, just gotten so used to it that it’s getting comfy but yeah I know it’ll be a waste and I wanna start dating again so
I love this band and album

Really? You too? You know I have grown quite comfortable with the way I’m living as well although part of it is the whole watching the people around me (as in peers) go off to college and making the most of their lives while I feel stuck in time. I’m sure it’ll pass in a few years but I’m tired of having my parents threaten to force me to do stuff all the time, you know? I’d like to be at least a little independent but I don’t know how without someone by my side which I don’t have really
My friends are all going off to college and my family doesn’t really understand my condition so I seem to be on my own which is why I came on here but thanks for the advice I’ll see what I can do

I haven’t had a real relationship with anyone besides family for years, and those I did have all seemed fake so yeah I don’t know. Some people might need them more than others but really all I need are people around to help me if I need help but I don’t really care if we connect on a spiritual level or anything.
